model: MicroTech III Applied Rooftop and Self-Contained Unit Controller
applies_to: Rebel (DPS/DPH), Maverick (MPS), RoofPak rooftops and air handlers (RPS, RDT, RFS, RDS, RAH, RPE, RDE) and SWP/SWT self-contained units.
summary: The MicroTech III applied air controller is shared by Daikin Applied packaged rooftops, RoofPak air handlers and self-contained units, and exposes one BACnet object list over the BACnet IP or MS/TP communication module. Points cover unit and mode status, occupancy scheduling, temperatures, duct and building static pressure, fan capacity, cooling, heating, dehumidification, energy recovery, run hours and read-only unit configuration. Many objects only apply to certain unit types or options, and most network inputs require AHU Loc/Net (MV 38) to be set to Network at the keypad.
notes: Initial device instance is calculated from the production code (IP) or MAC address (MS/TP); change it at the keypad.
AHU Loc/Net (MV 38) must be Network for most writable network points to apply; it can only be changed at the keypad.
Points depend on unit type (RTU, SCU, MPS, DPS, DPH) and installed options.
MV 1 object name is printed as 'Daikin AppliedStatus' (older units may report McQuayStatus).
File objects are only available with BACnet firmware 9.26 and later.
Range text lists units in English and SI; English units shown here.
BACnet alarm and event objects (Tables 41-44: warning, problem and fault alarm BIs/BVs and event BIs) are included; alarm BVs are legacy-only.

source.title: MicroTech III Unit Controller Protocol Information - Commercial Packaged Rooftop, Applied Rooftop and Self-Contained Systems

integration.summary: Set AHU Loc/Net to Network at the keypad, then drive the unit with Occupancy Mode or the Occupancy Scheduler Input, plus Application Mode and network setpoints. Use Emergency Override to stop the unit from the network, and read Unit State, unit status, capacities, temperatures and alarm objects.

minimum_points.name: CurrentState
minimum_points.why: Occupancy Scheduler Input when Occupancy Mode is Auto

minimum_points.name: AHULoc/Net
minimum_points.why: Must read Network for network inputs to apply

integration.enable: AHU Loc/Net (MV 38) must be set to Network at the keypad/display (it is read-only over BACnet) for most network inputs to apply. Occupancy is then commanded with Occupancy Mode (MV 7) or, when Occupancy Mode is Auto, the Occupancy Scheduler Input (MV 8/MV 9/AV 3). Emergency Override (MV 10) = Off shuts the unit off (Unit Status OffNet) and only writing Normal restarts it. Application Mode (MV 5) only takes effect when Control Mode is Auto, which is set at the keypad.
integration.heartbeat: Receive Heartbeat (AV 43, 0-6553.4 s, default 0 s) sets how long after the last update of the heartbeat-supervised network parameters the controller falls back to its default values. The guide says it is not supported on application versions 2506017300 or newer.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature Input (AV 28) and Outdoor Air Temperature Input (AV 29) accept network temperatures; the space value falls back to the local sensor if the network value becomes unreliable, and out-of-range OA writes revert to Null. Network inputs also exist for space humidity (AV 19), space CO2/IAQ (AV 31), supply/return/exhaust fan capacity and minimum OA position. The relevant unit option or sensor type must be configured for each to apply.
setup: Initial device instance is calculated from the production code (IP) or MAC address (MS/TP); change it at the keypad and use Apply Changes in the BACnet setup menu.
BACnet IP defaults: DHCP on, given IP 127.0.0.1, mask 255.255.255.0, UDP port 47808.
BACnet MS/TP defaults: MAC address 18, 38400 baud, Max Master 127, Max Info Frames 1.
MS/TP terminating resistor is a keypad setting (Term Resistor); a physical resistor is recommended.
gotchas: Points from the 2009 revision were changed from commandable to writable for the heartbeat function; most network points are plain writes.
Writing ClearAlarms (MV 13) continuously is discouraged; use it only to clear an active alarm.
Many objects apply only to certain unit types (RTU, SCU, MPS, DPS, DPH) or installed options.
File objects need BACnet firmware 9.26 or later.
Alarm BVs are legacy only and missing on current firmware; the guide advises against writing them.
